# Which building types gain from a raw material anywhere in the province the panel is showing.
# Scope: building_type
bag_rgo_has_local_bonus = {
	has_global_variable = bag_view_location
	OR = {
		AND = {
			bag_rgo_consumes_alum = yes
			global_var:bag_view_location = { province = { any_location_in_province = { raw_material = goods:alum } } }
		}
		AND = {
			bag_rgo_consumes_amber = yes
			global_var:bag_view_location = { province = { any_location_in_province = { raw_material = goods:amber } } }

# Scope: building_type

	has_global_variable = bag_view_location

		AND = {
			bag_rgo_consumes_alum = yes
